First conceived by [[Evin Yarrow]] during the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], '''Yarrow Industries'''' main source of revenue was gained through the production of cheap and inexpensive [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]s, and small [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Evin Yarrow's ex-wife, Dantrua Haggi, had valuable contacts within the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and was able to secure large loans to help fuel the business in its earlier stages. After the InterGalactic Banking Clan's investment in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Allies]] in the Clone Wars went dry, Evin Yarrow eventually decided to withdraw from the now waning galactic economical power. Yarrow Industries would also later unknowingly benefit from its former allegations by means of the secretly invested billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] fed to the InterGalactic Banking Clan and expand to be a market leader during the Galactic Empire's 19 year reign under [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
